full_details: At breakfast the Sunday letter was still folded for Thursday. Mistress Ansell filled the horn for twopence, because yesterday's spoon had been in the galls. You paid threepence for the meal. You did not know whether your father's cough was gone. At the Cross Keys you went on in the paper crown. The house was two-thirds of Thursday's, and louder. The Inns called "Remuneration!" before the line, and the gallery took up the long Latin word with Costard. Kemp added thirteen lines. Garnish's tally stood at twenty-four in two days. Kemp said they had laughed at his lines, and that he had counted. A lawyer at the parlour door asked who made the play, and Burbage pointed with his thumb. You told Burbage what the yard did with the ending, not what you had meant. James Burbage wants you at the Theatre in the morning, at ten of the clock, and not at nine in the yard.
one_sentence: You bought a horn of ink for twopence, played Navarre at two, and heard Kemp's thirteen lines make twenty-four.
title: Twenty-four lines in two days
